exposure: ultrasound diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: The study enrolled 845 singleton pregnant patients with placenta previa from two hospitals.
finding: The Gradient Boosting Machine model demonstrated excellent performance in predicting postpartum hemorrhage in cases of placenta previa, with key predictive variables including d-dimer, ultrasound diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum, neutrophils, prothrombin time, and platelets.
